title: Axiomatizations of the proportional division value
headline: Confirmed finding with an author-supplied correction: the sufficiency direction of Theorem 1 fails under the displayed game-by-game coefficient conditions, and the authors supplied a corrected characterization.

work.title: Axiomatizations of the proportional division value

claims.label: Theorem 1 sufficiency direction
claims.gist: The printed pointwise coefficient restrictions are stated to imply efficiency, weak linearity, and proportional-balanced treatment.
claims.statement: For every individually positive or individually negative TU-game, the displayed representation with coefficients satisfying the displayed same-size restriction implies efficiency, weak linearity, and proportional-balanced treatment.
conditions: The domain consists of TU-games whose singleton worths are all strictly positive or all strictly negative.
The representation and coefficient restriction are imposed separately for each game; the statement does not require coefficients to agree across games.
claims.quantifiers: The theorem compares all games in the stated domain. Weak linearity also compares different games with proportional singleton-worth vectors, while the printed coefficient condition links coefficients only within one game.

result.summary: A value defined on the full three-player domain satisfies the printed representation and coefficient restriction, efficiency, and proportional-balanced treatment, but violates weak linearity at a game and its double.
result.witness: Let \(N=\{1,2,3\}\). For every game with singleton worths \(x_i\) of one strict sign, set \(\lambda_{ij}=(x_i+x_j)x_k\) for \(\{i,j,k\}=N\). Then \(\lambda_{ij}/((x_i+x_j)x_k)=1\) for each pair, so the same-size restriction holds for every game. For the game \(v\) with singleton worths \((1,1,1)\), pair worths \((1,2,4)\), and grand-coalition worth \(1\), direct substitution gives \(\psi(v)=(-14/3,4/3,13/3)\), while \(\psi(2v)=(-118/3,26/3,98/3)\).
result.argument: The coefficients are defined for every individually positive or negative singleton vector, and all denominators are nonzero. The representation is efficient and satisfies proportional-balanced treatment by the displayed algebra. The numerical witness has \(2\psi(v)=(-28/3,8/3,26/3)\), which differs from \(\psi(2v)\); weak linearity therefore fails even though every nonempty coalition worth in \(v\) is positive. The failure is that the pointwise condition permits raw coefficients to change across games with proportional singleton worths.
not_claimed: The necessity direction of Theorem 1 is false.
The corrected characterization supplied by the authors is false.
The proportional division value or later results in the paper are thereby invalidated.
A public journal or arXiv correction has been independently verified.
result.repair_note: Require the raw coefficients to be invariant across games whose singleton-worth vectors lie on the same nonzero line. The authors supplied a four-page correction note adding this restriction and a necessity argument; a subsequent separate AI review found the corrected characterization valid.

vor_check.detail: The Version of Record PDF was checked at printed page 40 for Theorem 1 and its displayed coefficient conditions.

evidence.detail: A fresh separate-session hostile review checked the theorem reading, full-domain construction, displayed coefficient restriction, three axioms, scaling failure, alternative interpretations, and proposed repair.

author_response.covers: One author agreed with the identified sufficiency gap and counterexample, accepted the proposed coefficient restriction, and supplied a four-page correction note giving a corrected characterization.

correction.note: The author supplied a four-page correction note revising Theorem 1 to add the cross-game coefficient restriction and giving a necessity argument. No public journal or arXiv correction is independently verified in this record.
